listing.name: Soulcalibur II HD Online — Soulcalibur2HD-recomp (n0madic)
listing.summary: The project reports fights working on Mac and Windows. Linux has only been tested to a window under WSL with software Vulkan. Frame flashes and input-testing gaps remain. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA PSN NPUB31366 game PKG and RAP. Versions 01.00 and 01.01 are accepted; update 01.01 is optional.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the release ZIP for your host with its Python3.10 launcher. It compiles your own game locally using clang or the pinned Zig0.17 toolchain.

warnings: The project reports fights working on Mac and Windows. Linux has only been tested to a window under WSL with software Vulkan. Frame flashes and input-testing gaps remain.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
